card.name: Just before timolol in eye drops
card.fires_on: The spot right before the drug name timolol appears in ophthalmic labels, especially the split 't' in 'brimonidine tartrate/timolol' and linking words like 'and', 'such as' and 'of' before timolol or beta-blockers.

modes.label: Split inside combo name
modes.description: The 't' piece that begins timolol after 'brimonidine tartrate' in the combination eye drop name.

modes.label: Linking word before timolol
modes.description: A small linking word such as 'and' or 'as' just ahead of a predicted timolol maleate mention.
modes.example: Dorzolamide hydrochloride<< and>> timolol maleate ophthalmic

card.writes: It suppresses the word 'tim' forms and promotes other 'im' continuations, so it appears to steer the output away from tim-starting words as the next piece.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name timolol, the beta-blocker in combination eye drops.
evidence: Dorzolamide hydrochloride<< and>> timolol maleate ophthalmic
